description: This file defines the Tooltip class for the Leaflet mapping library, extending DivOverlay to display small text labels on map layers. It includes methods for managing tooltip appearance, positioning, and interaction with map and layer events.

classes.name: Tooltip
classes.description: A class extending DivOverlay used to display small text labels on map layers, with options for positioning, interactivity, and appearance.

methods.name: onAdd
methods.description: Called when the tooltip is added to the map; sets opacity and fires tooltipopen events.

methods.name: onRemove
methods.description: Called when the tooltip is removed from the map; fires tooltipclose events.

methods.name: getEvents
methods.description: Returns event handlers for the tooltip, including handling for touch devices.

methods.name: _close
methods.description: Closes the tooltip by instructing the map to close it.

methods.name: _setPosition
methods.description: Calculates and sets the tooltip's position based on options and map state.

methods.name: _updatePosition
methods.description: Updates tooltip position based on its geographic location.

methods.name: setOpacity
methods.description: Sets the opacity of the tooltip container.

methods.name: _animateZoom
methods.description: Adjusts tooltip position during map zoom animations.

methods.name: _getAnchor
methods.description: Determines the anchor point for the tooltip on its source layer.
